Senior Applied Scientist

Datadog · Paris

Real Job Listing Paris Full-time arbeitnow,arbeitnow-page-1

Senior Applied Scientist at Datadog. Paris. Apply for this Senior Applied Scientist opportunity through the original employer or job source.

Job Description

&lt;p&gt;The Applied AI team designs and builds algorithmically driven features in the Datadog app. We work across a range of applications, primarily focusing on analysis on streaming data such as &lt;a href="https://www.datadoghq.com/blog/watchdog/"&gt;anomaly detection&lt;/a&gt;, &lt;a href="https://docs.datadoghq.com/logs/explorer/watchdog_insights/"&gt;error outliers&lt;/a&gt; and &lt;a href="https://www.datadoghq.com/blog/faulty-deployment-detection/"&gt;faulty deployment analysis&lt;/a&gt;. As an Applied Scientist you will work on building models and algorithms for machine learning powered features within the Datadog platform. You will work closely with our engineering and product partners to explore, build, scale and deliver these features that we incubate within the Applied AI team.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our employees can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.&lt;/em&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="592"&gt;&lt;strong data-renderer-mark="true"&gt;What You’ll Do: &lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;ul&gt; &lt;li&gt;Design solutions for our different use cases. You will research and benchmark relevant algorithms to find the best fit for our use-cases&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Leverage machine learning algorithms and statistical techniques to build new scalable product features&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Develop, deploy and monitor new and existing features to production&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Participate in our journal club by reading and presenting the latest academic research papers to the team&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Explore, analyze and tell the story behind high volumes of data flowing through Datadog systems &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Maintain and monitor the models, services and infrastructure owned by your team&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Participate in your team’s on-call rotation&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ul&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="1335"&gt;&lt;strong data-renderer-mark="true"&gt;Who You Are: &lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;ul&gt; &lt;li&gt;You have a BS/MS/PhD in a Computer Science, Engineering, Machine Learning or related scientific field or equivalent experience&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;You have experience working with high-scale systems and datasets including building models, applying machine learning to real business problems, and writing production data pipelines&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;You can explain complex ideas and algorithms to non-technical audiences&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;You care about code simplicity and performance&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;You are excited to work on a user-facing product&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ul&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="2625"&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="2627"&gt;&lt;em data-renderer-mark="true"&gt;Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply. &lt;/em&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="2627"&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="2863"&gt;&lt;strong data-renderer-mark="true"&gt;Benefits and Growth: &lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;ul&gt; &lt;li&gt;Competitive global benefits&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Opportunity to collaborate closely with colleagues across the Datadog offices in New York City and Paris&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Opportunity to attend and present at conferences and meetups&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ul&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.&lt;/em&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p style="color: white;"&gt;#LI-Hybrid&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="content-conclusion"&gt;&lt;hr&gt; &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About Datadog: &lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on &lt;a href="https://www.instagram.com/datadoghq/?hl=en" target="_blank"&gt;Instagram&lt;/a&gt;, &lt;a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/datadog" target="_blank"&gt;LinkedIn,&lt;/a&gt; and &lt;a href="https://learn.datadoghq.com/" target="_blank"&gt;Datadog Learning Center. &lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;hr&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="215"&gt;&lt;strong data-renderer-mark="true"&gt;Equal Opportunity at Datadog:&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Datadog is proud to offer &lt;a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights6.12ScreenRdr.pdf" target="_blank"&gt;equal employment opportunity&lt;/a&gt; to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and other characteristics protected by law.
